svg.text: Keyword-family matrix (maintainers): every language against every family
2,893 cells have a rule: 91 measured against a parser, 721 decoy test only, 2,081 not tested; 2,290 cells are N/A. Hover a cell for numbers. The README figure is the summary of this.
Cell colour = the lower of recall and precision. Faded: under 10 functions. Hatched: corpus not pinned (exploratory).
